subject: Greenridge AI — swap economics inquiry and bundling questions
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@greenridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenridge.ai>
Date: 2027-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Competitive review — can Redwood match + packaging questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. We're working through a competitive review and would like a concrete economics comparison to our incumbent. Two things we need to evaluate:

1) A line-item comparison of unit economics (per-token/embedding) at our current monthly run rate (approx 3.6B tokens/month, occasional spikes) — please show net price after any credits.
2) Packaging/ops questions: what are the costs and constraints if we take Redwood Private (VPC) vs Dedicated vs Hosted for our use case? Specifically curious about base reserved commit, seat tiers, and any migration/onboarding credits.

We have a procurement deadline of end of month and a redline template ready. Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to provide a one-time onboarding credit and outline the discount bands you typically offer for multi-quarter commitments?

Thanks — attaching our commercial worksheet and the incumbent quote for reference.

Samantha Cho
Head of Procurement | Greenridge AI
Samantha.cho@greenridge.ai
Attachment: greenridge_pricing_request.pdf (commercial worksheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@greenridge.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenridge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Competitive review — can Redwood match + packaging questions

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet.

Quick answers up front: yes, we can put together a line-item comparison and a consolidated offer that includes a limited onboarding credit for a 6–12 month commit. The specific size of the credit and the discount tiers depend on committed run-rate and whether you choose Dedicated or Private.

To build the comparison we need:
- Clarify the incumbent's effective per-token or per-embedding line after any usage tiers (the worksheet helps but I want the final monthly numbers you expect to pay).
- Confirmation of your prefered deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and whether data residency (EU) matters for the pilot.
- Typical 99th percentile latency SLO you're aiming for (we can calibrate batch/latency tradeoffs).

Marissa — looping you in to propose comps/discount bands and confirm the sizing for the credit. Karthik, can you weigh in on the packaging delta (ops & HSM/KMS lift) for Greenridge's expected traffic?

I'll slot a 30-min review for Tuesday to align on the commercial sketch — does 10:00 AM PT work for everyone?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T13:28:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Greenridge pricing sketch + recommended bands

Jonas / Karthik — summary draft for our call with Greenridge. Attaching a quick spreadsheet version.

Key levers we can flex:
- Commitment term: 3/6/12 months. Biggest uplift at 12-month commit (we can go to ~30% off list for token rates vs standard hosted list).
- Onboarding credit: 20–30k USD one-time for 6-month pilots, scalable with larger commits.
- Dedicated & Private delta: Private has a platform fee and integration lift (we typically charge an incremental infrastructure onboarding fee ~40–60k and a monthly base reserve). Dedicated has lower upfront but less isolation.
- Seat tiers & runtime bundles: offer tiered seat discounts for admin seats, and bundle a 5% runtime-performance credit if they accept our quantization profile and KV-caching config (reduces per-token cost effectively).

Sourced numbers (ballpark) in pricing_comparison.xlsx: list vs proposed net at 3.6B tokens/month. Note: the incumbent currently includes a limited egress credit; we should match that for first 90 days.

Strategy ask: I'd lead with a 12-month commit with a 25% net discount + $30k onboarding credit, plus a 90-day egress waiver. If they push back, we can offer a 6-month with smaller credit and a runway to renew.

I'll bring the sheet to the call. Karthik — any last-minute migration cost assumptions we should bake into the offer?

— Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricing_comparison.xlsx (internal)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-19T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Greenridge pricing sketch + recommended bands

Marissa — quick technical notes to include in the commercial sketch:

1) Private deployment delta: expect an initial integration window of ~4–6 weeks for VPC peering, KMS integration, and SOC evidence handoff. We estimate service engineering time roughly equivalent to 0.6 FTE for initial onboarding (we typically cover first 0.2 FTE in onboarding credit; larger customers require heavier SRE support).

2) Quantization/packaging: If Greenridge adopts our 8-bit quantized runtime and prefix KV caching we can reduce their per-token compute footprint by ~22–28% depending on sequence-length distribution. That’s an operational lever we should make explicit as a performance credit rather than a pure price cut — easier to measure and tie to quality SLAs.

3) Migration risks: model compatibility is high for their primary model family, but some custom ops used in their pipeline may need work-arounds. Recommend a short compatibility pilot (2 weeks) in Dedicated to validate perf/latency. We can include a small pilot credit (~$10k) to cover compute costs for compatibility testing.

4) Compliance: they asked for SOC2 artifacts. We can provide our SOC2 report and a redacted runbook; if they need on-prem evidence (air-gapped) there’ll be additional legal & engineering time (estimate 20–30k).

I’ll be on the Tuesday 10:00 AM PT call.

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Inference Services | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@greenridge.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenridge.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Consolidated offer & next steps (Greenridge)

Samantha — thanks again for the worksheet and the call today. Below is the consolidated offer and next steps. I’ve attached a one-page condensed offer PDF for procurement.

Offer (summary):
- 12-month commit at expected baseline usage (3.6B tokens/month)
- Net token/embedding pricing: 25% off list for Hosted baseline; equivalent net for Dedicated when combined with a $30k onboarding credit and a 90-day egress waiver.
- Private: Platform onboarding fee estimated at $50k (covers KMS/HSM integration & baseline SRE) — we propose Redwood covers $30k of that as a one-time credit for this deal.
- Pilot: 2-week Dedicated compatibility pilot with $10k compute credit included.
- Quantization performance credit: if Greenridge adopts our 8-bit runtime + KV caching config, we’ll apply a 5% performance credit to monthly invoices (measured against an agreed baseline prompt set).

Next steps:
1) Procurement point-of-contact and legal redline timeline (please share contact).
2) I’ve opened a HubSpot deal (HD-1138) and attached the condensed offer to the record.
3) If procurement is comfortable, I can send a preliminary SOW/DocuSign for the onboarding credit and pilot scope by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: redwood-consolidated-offer.pdf

Quoted for clarity:
> "Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to provide a one-time onboarding credit and outline the discount bands you typically offer for multi-quarter commitments?"

Yes — the credit and discount bands are summarized above. We modeled the math in the attached spreadsheet and are happy to adjust structure (term vs. upfront credit) to match Greenridge's P&L preference.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
